RADISH RASCALS - a RetroStone VC game for Windows
(c) 2026 Pierre-Louis Boyer (8BCraft).
Code MIT; art/music/sound CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.

Run RadishRascals.exe. No installation or extra DLLs needed.
Protect four vegetable beds. Press the D-pad direction matching a rabbit to shoo it away.
Shaking soil warns of an arrival. Leave friendly hedgehogs alone!
One missed rabbit or wrong shoo ends your run. Correct replies build a combo.
The opening pace now matches the old speed around 1300 points. Visitors initially
arrive every 0.9 seconds, with about 0.67 seconds to reply after emerging.
This gradually reaches 0.63-second spacing and a 0.53-second response window.
The larger gardener faces left, right, front or back and thrusts a pitchfork toward the selected
bed. Look for planted radishes, soil warnings and friendly hedgehogs in the beds.
Controls: UP / RIGHT / DOWN / LEFT keyboard arrows; P2: W / D / S / A.
X / Z / C / V or a gamepad face button starts from the title; natural directions also start.
Enter starts, pauses and resumes. Backspace / Esc / Right Shift also pause.
After results, X / gamepad A returns to the title.
Players 2-4 join with A on the title and leave with B. P1 starts the game.
P2 keyboard: H joins, G leaves, T Start, R Select. Up to four gamepads work.
Every player has a separate view and a distinct character colour.
F11 or Alt+Enter toggles fullscreen. F12 takes a screenshot.
Best scores are saved to radishrascals.srm next to the executable.
